requirement: Report whether a clinical metric is a scoring system: true when every rule is a scoring rule, false when every rule is a major/minor rule or when the metric has no rule, and an ArgumentException when the rule types are mixed.

preconditions.text: The metric rule collection is built in memory
Every rule of the metric is of the same kind, or the collection is empty

returns.text: True when all rules are scoring rules
False when all rules are major/minor rules
False when the metric has no rule
ArgumentException is thrown for a mixed rule collection

exception_text: ArgumentException is thrown when the metric mixes scoring and major/minor rules
